fix_results.fix_summary: Fixed bug #163 by hiding the 'New Game' button on the game finished page for daily challenges. The 'New Game' button navigates to the game setup screen (coordinator.showSetup()) where users can change categories, which doesn't make sense for daily challenges since they have a fixed category. Added a conditional check `if !gameManager.isDailyChallenge` around the 'New Game' button (lines 79-110), following the same pattern used for the 'Play Again' button. This ensures that daily challenge users only see the 'Main Menu' button to return to the main menu, preventing confusion about changing categories when there is no other category to go to.
